figures.caption: Fig. 1: Overview of the proposed PReS framework for B2-UniDA. PReS progressively constructs sample- and label-level supervision from complementary knowledge sources, performs asymmetric target learning, and exploits the emerging targetdomain knowledge to refine the supervision throughout adaptation. Solid and dashed arrows denote the forward adaptation flow and progressive feedback, respectively. Only the adapted target model is required during inference.
TABLE III: H-score (%) comparison under OPDA on Office-Home. Italic, underlined, and bold denote the best UniDA, SFUniDA, and B2-UniDA results, respectively.

TABLE II: H-score (%) comparison under OPDA on Office-31, VisDA, and DomainNet. Italic, underlined, and bold denote the best UniDA, SF-UniDA, and B2-UniDA results, respectively. ‘–’ denotes unavailable results.

Fig. 2: Ablation results of Reliability-aware Pseudo-label Generation on Office-Home under OPDA. “only Src” and “only CLIP” use predictions from the black-box source model and CLIP alone, respectively, while “average” equally averages their predictions.
TABLE IV: H-score (%) comparison under OSDA on Office-Home, Office-31, and VisDA. Italic, underlined, and bold denote the best UniDA, SF-UniDA, and B2-UniDA results, respectively.
TABLE VI: Accuracy (%) comparison under CDA on Office-Home and Office-31. Italic, underlined, and bold denote the best UniDA, SF-UniDA, and B2-UniDA results, respectively.
TABLE V: Accuracy (%) comparison under PDA on Office-Home, Office-31, and VisDA. Italic, underlined, and bold denote the best UniDA, SF-UniDA, and B2-UniDA results, respectively.
Fig. 3: Ablation results of Progressive Supervision Refinement (PSR) on Office-Home under OPDA. “w/o SPR” and “w/o PLR” disable SPR and PLR, respectively, while “w/o PSR” disables both.

Fig. 4: t-SNE visualization of target features learned by SO and PReS for D→A on Office-31 and Pr→Rw on Office-Home under OPDA. Colored and black points represent samples from the shared and target-private classes, respectively. (Best viewed in color and zoomed in.)
Fig. 6: Sensitivity of PReS to β and γ on Office-31 under OPDA. Subfigures (a) and (c) show task-wise H-scores, while (b) and (d) show the corresponding averages.
Fig. 7: Sensitivity of PReS to the refinement starting epoch t on Office-31 under OPDA.
